action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oread attacks twice with its fiery touch or fire bolt.

action.name: Fiery Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Invisible in Fire
entries: The oread is {@condition invisible} while fully immersed in fire.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The oread has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
